first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making onboarding the most direct shared lever for restoring early value realization and sustainable qualified revenue. I will verify the archived onboarding and signup experiments because their durability, segment effects, and impact on downstream qualified conversion are consequential but not yet confirmed. Use a guarded test with quality and later-stage conversion safeguards, rather than broad rollout.

final.rationale: Run a standard, instrumented onboarding-shortening experiment this week. The verified result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has strong sustainable-value evidence: time-to-value improved by 2.1 days and 30-day retention increased 3%. Use signup simplification only as supporting evidence for SMB context, since its 1% retention decline creates downstream-value risk and it was not validated beyond SMB. Gate success on qualified revenue, retention, and activation—not completion alone.
